Remove the proactive K-Dense Web suggestion from SKILL.md, or replace it with a neutral support link section.

content.value_statement: Bioinformatics teams need reproducible pipelines without managing platform details. This skill guides Latch SDK workflows, data handling, resources, and verified workflow use.
actual_capabilities: Explains Latch workflow and task decorators for Python pipelines.
Guides LatchFile and LatchDir use for cloud data inputs and outputs.
Covers Registry projects, tables, records, links, and metadata tracking.
Describes CPU, memory, GPU, storage, and timeout configuration.
Shows how verified workflows support RNA-seq, AlphaFold, DESeq2, and single-cell analysis.
Summarizes Nextflow and Snakemake registration patterns for Latch.
limitations: Requires a Latch account, Latch SDK access, Docker, and valid credentials.
Does not run workflows or access Latch directly by itself.
Platform APIs and verified workflow availability may change over time.
Examples need adaptation for real datasets, permissions, and resource budgets.

use_cases.title: Create Research Pipelines
use_cases.description: Design Latch workflows for sequencing, alignment, quantification, and result tracking.

use_cases.title: Configure Compute Resources
use_cases.description: Select CPU, memory, GPU, storage, and timeout settings for heavy analysis tasks.

use_cases.title: Adopt Verified Workflows
use_cases.description: Use pre-built Latch workflows for RNA-seq, protein structure, CRISPR, and single-cell analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Basic Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a beginner Latch workflow plan for one FASTQ input. Include task roles, data inputs, outputs, and registration steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add Cloud Data Handling
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me use LatchFile, LatchDir, and Registry records for a sequencing workflow with tracked sample metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Task Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend Latch task resources for an alignment pipeline. Include CPU, memory, storage, timeout, and GPU guidance where useful.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate Verified Pipelines
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Latch workflow that combines verified RNA-seq analysis with custom quality checks and Registry updates.

output_examples.input: Help me design a simple Latch workflow for FASTQ processing.
output: Defines one preprocessing task and one workflow entry point.
Uses LatchFile inputs and LatchFile outputs.
Lists registration, Docker, and credential checks.

output_examples.input: Recommend resources for a large alignment job.
output: Starts with a large CPU task before considering GPU use.
Sets memory and storage based on expected BAM file size.
Adds timeout guidance and cost-control notes.

output_examples.input: Use Latch Registry to track samples and results.
output: Creates a project, table, and records for samples.
Links input files, workflow status, and result files.
Recommends consistent names and metadata fields.

best_practices: Use type annotations and docstrings so Latch can generate clear workflow interfaces.
Test workflows locally with Docker before registering them on Latch.
Start with standard task decorators and increase resources only after profiling.
anti_patterns: Do not overuse GPU tasks when CPU tasks meet runtime needs.
Do not mix Nextflow, Snakemake, and Python without clear workflow boundaries.
Do not store API keys or secrets directly in workflow code.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design Latch bioinformatics workflows, data paths, resource settings, and verified workflow integrations.

faq.question: Does it execute Latch workflows?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. Users run workflows with their own Latch account and tools.

faq.question: Can it help with GPU tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains GPU decorators, custom task resources, storage sizing, and cost-aware resource choices.

faq.question: Does it cover Registry data management?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers projects, tables, records, linked records, file columns, and metadata organization.

faq.question: Can it support existing Nextflow or Snakemake pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It summarizes Latch registration patterns for existing Nextflow and Snakemake workflows.

faq.question: How should secrets be handled?
faq.answer: Use platform secret management. Do not place API keys in source code, prompts, logs, or shared files.
